core_meaning.primary_meaning: Beyza corresponds to the Arabic form بَيْضَاء and is glossed in this record as “White, bright.” The record associates the form with root ب ي ض (b-y-ḍ). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Beyza corresponds to the Arabic form بَيْضَاء (Arabic root ب ي ض (b-y-ḍ); بَيْضَاء (Bayḍāʾ)). Its core sense is beyza; white, bright (feminine). Beyza is the Turkish form of Arabic بَيْضَاء (Bayḍāʾ), the feminine of أَبْيَض, meaning 'white, bright'.

persian.name: بیضا
persian.long_meaning: Beyza (بیضا) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن بیضا، سپید است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
